epic.title: Unblock Mycelium: the 15-minute gates, worked first
epic.description:
Phil's own gating jobs, each a 15-minute ticket worked before anything else, each naming what it unlocks (11.7). The order of everything is the unblock queue, then voice capture, notes, the connector and imports (11.29).

## Order
First, needing nothing from Phil: keys.06 (Claude's census of credential files on the PC; report only, nothing deleted). Then Phil's queue, top to bottom:
1. MYC-195, Enable Banking sign-up: unlocks every Finance ticket that reads transactions.
2. MYC-201, the mailbox Mycelium reads: unlocks the parcels panel and the owed-replies feed.
3. MYC-197, the iPhone Shortcuts: unlocks voice capture from the phone, Spores and the glasses prototype.
4. MYC-182, the three answers (backup drive, due date, photo frame): unlocks the real baby dates, the frame tickets and the off-site backup.
5. MYC-196, rotate the two exposed secrets: unlocks the Mycelium part of rotate everything.
6. MYC-194, the email service: unlocks invite emails, so Kirsty can be invited.
7. MYC-205, the wall PIN and Kitchen wall: unlocks living with the wall on the frame.
8. MYC-180, the cron-job.org job: unlocks timed prompts when the PC is off.
9. MYC-210, the 2026-11-24 overnight report: unlocks the PhirstMaxx confirmations.
10. MYC-198, who may switch on paid AI: unlocks a new person's AI settings.
11. MYC-204, the two per-person AI model choices: unlocks the per-person model settings.
12. MYC-203, the Boys' seven bots: unlocks the Boys speaking in the group chat.
13. MYC-192, the UI calls: unlocks the Home design question round.
14. MYC-200, Cloudflare R2 for family photos: unlocks family photos in storage.
15. MYC-202, the GitHub token (optional): unlocks the GitHub watcher at full rate (optional).

unblock.02 checks this order is set on production.

## Done means
Every ticket under this epic is Done, and each one's Unlocks list has moved forward.

## Flags
None raised against this epic. Key rotation stays after the new Shortcuts and the API_SECRET caller list (MYC-209), as Phil instructed on 2026-11-24.

## Dossier
The research dossier is attached in Docs.

## Red team
- Finding 50: keys.06 (the census files check) is the first item and sits under this epic; MYC-182 (the due date) is the second because 39 dates hang on it.

tickets.title: Start here: the first evening after the 2026-11-28 run
tickets.description:
## What
Two 15-minute sittings: see what the unattended run built (the Field shell, the Guides list, the map), give the due date that 39 baby tickets hang on, park the decisions review for tomorrow, then do the first two unblock jobs (the bank sign-up, the census report).

## Why
The brief's day one (T7): one place to start, written as a full Field guide.

## Done looks like
Both sittings ticked; the hand-back pasted to Claude.

## Unlocks
Every dated baby ticket, every Finance feed ticket, the decisions review.

## Depends on
Nothing. This is the first ticket.

steps_definition.title: Start here: the first evening after the 2026-11-28 run

intro.answer: Two sittings. The first shows you what the run built and asks the one question 39 dates hang on. The second is your first two unblock jobs.
unlocks: Every dated baby ticket (they move with the due date)
Every Finance ticket that reads transactions
to_hand: The due date from the scan letter

hard_part.why: The bank sign-up is the one sitting only you can do and it gates all of Finance.

phases.title: See what the run did, and answer the one question

steps.title: Switch the shell to Field
steps.body_html: Choose Field. The page reloads with a menu bar across the top and a calmer palette. Classic is one click away in the same place if you want it back.
steps.expect_html: A top menu bar; Home is a grid of tiles with today in the largest.

steps.title: Open the Guides list

where.label: Work, Guides in the top menu

steps.body_html: Open Work and choose Guides. This guide is in the list; so is the decisions review.
steps.expect_html: A list of guides, newest first, each with a small progress thread.

steps.title: Read the map

where.label: Docs, space RUN, page "Map: the 2026-11-28 run"

steps.body_html: Open the map page. It shows the 24 threads, which waits on which, and where each starts.
steps.expect_html: A diagram of the epics and a start ticket under each.

steps.title: Give the due date
steps.body_html: Open MYC-182 and type the due date from the scan letter into its answer box, then tick it. Thirty-nine baby tickets and the two leave-notice deadlines move with it.
steps.expect_html: MYC-182 ticked with a date in the box.

steps.title: Open the decisions review and park it for tomorrow

where.label: Guides, "Review: decisions made for me on 2026-11-28"

steps.body_html: Open it, read the top box, then press Park so it sits on tomorrow's list. Each of its rows is one decision made for you tonight: tick to keep, write in the box to undo.
steps.expect_html: The guide shows a parked banner and tomorrow's Home shows it.

verify_html: Claude reads MYC-182's answer and re-dates the baby tickets; you will see the new dates on the baby epic the next morning.
phases.why_html: Everything in the plan hangs off the due date and your review of the decisions; nothing else is as cheap to get right first.

phases.title: The first two unblock jobs

steps.title: Enable Banking sign-up
steps.body_html: Open MYC-195 and follow its steps: the sign-up, then linking Halifax, Revolut and AMEX in its control panel. Stop at the first bank if it is not listed and say so in the box.
steps.expect_html: MYC-195 ticked, or a note naming the bank that was missing.

steps.title: Read Claude's census report
steps.body_html: Open the census-files ticket and read Claude's report of what credential files sit on the PC. Nothing was opened or deleted. Tick it when read; the acting is keys.07, later.

steps.title: Hand back
steps.body_html: Press Copy on the hand-back prompt at the bottom and paste it to Claude.
steps.expect_html: Claude confirms the due date is applied and the Finance feed is in progress.

verify_html: Claude checks MYC-195's state and the keys.06 tick.

steps_definition.finish_html: The run's work is in your hands: the Field shell on, the map read, the due date given, the first unblock done and the decisions review on tomorrow's list.
steps_definition.handback_prompt: I did the start-here guide from the 2026-11-28 run. The due date is {{due_date}}. Banks linked: {{banks_linked}}. Re-date the baby tickets, check MYC-195, and tell me what tonight's one thing is.

Set the tickets' rank in that order so the epic's list reads top to bottom as the order. Fix any that are missing.

## Why
Phil decided his gating jobs become one epic of 15-minute tickets, worked first, each naming what it unlocks (11.7), and the order starts with the unblock queue (11.29).

## Done looks like
The epic page lists the tickets in the written order and every one shows its Unlocks section.

## Unlocks
Every Phil's-queue ticket reads in order, so the next one is always the top one.

## Depends on
Nothing.

tickets.title: Kirsty's invite: what it waits on and what needs her (baby, budget, kitchen screen); a decision ticket
tickets.description:
## What
Claude writes on this ticket what the invite waits on today (the UI rebuild, MYC-194 so the invite email is sent, MYC-198 on paid AI for a new person) and what already needs her: baby prep, the household budget (fin.18) and the kitchen screen (wall.26). Phil reads it and comments with his decision: keep waiting for the UI rebuild, or invite her earlier for the parts that need her.

## Why
Phil decided Kirsty's invite keeps waiting for the UI rebuild (11.17); the question also noted that baby prep, the household budget and the kitchen screen all need her.

## Done looks like
Phil's decision is a comment on this ticket, and the dependent tickets are updated to match.

## Unlocks
fin.18 (shared costs), the baby tickets that need her, wall.26 (both use the kitchen screen).

## Depends on
Nothing to decide. Sending an invite needs MYC-194 and MYC-198.

## Flag
`[claude]` 11.17: the rebuild waits on a direction he is still thinking about, and baby prep, the budget and the kitchen screen all need her. Raised once; Phil's answer stands until he changes it here.

## Red team
- Finding 40: Until Kirsty has an account, her tickets are held in Phil's space marked 'for Kirsty'. Dated before baby.20 because baby prep, the household budget and the kitchen screen all need her (11.17).
